Container.Name: Hive-Tech-Forum
Container.Overview:
Hive Tech Forum — Next.js forum for tech, servers, and IPTV; free tier and Pro (Stripe).
Image: ghcr.io/killamfkr/hive:latest. Migrations run on container start. Seed categories once (terminal): docker exec -it Hive-Tech-Forum sh -c 'cd /app && npx prisma db seed'
Set NEXTAUTH_URL to your real public URL (https behind Swag/NPM). Stripe webhook path: /api/webhooks/stripe
If pull fails with unauthorized, set the GHCR package to public or configure registry login on Unraid.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database (forum.db) and persistent files. chown 1001:1001 if permission errors.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: SQLite path inside container; keep default when using /data mount.

Config.Name: NEXTAUTH_URL
Config.Description: Public site URL users visit (https://forum.example.com behind proxy)

Config.Name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Stripe secret key (optional if not using Pro billing)

Config.Name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID_PAID
Config.Description: Stripe Price ID for monthly Pro subscription

Config.Name: XUI_BASE_URL
Config.Description: XUI Admin API base URL ending in /accesscode

Config.Name: XUI_BOUQUET_IDS
Config.Description: Comma-separated bouquet IDs for new lines

Config.Name: XUI_MAX_CONNECTIONS
Config.Description: Max concurrent connections per XUI line

Config.Name: XUI_SUBSCRIPTION_LENGTH
Config.Description: Days for XUI exp_date (numeric = N days)
